scope: Original PCM measured, graph fixture and actual controlled page DOM. Not an auditory fidelity or physical speaker certification.

checks.name: Three exact stage IDs expose nine original layers, not generic or copied recordings
Mixed stereo PCM is bounded, nonzero, finite and seamless over 12 seconds
All nine solo layers are audible-valued and have distinct PCM fingerprints
Sample rate is bounded and invalid room or layer cannot cause arbitrary allocation
Synthesis is deterministic and never consults the combat/global random source
Full mix equals its three authored stems and retains distinct stereo channels
No audio context or sound starts without a trusted activation and enabled settings
Timeline frame gives an exact buffer offset while only one ambience voice exists
Steady updates reuse their node; a large seek resynchronizes from the requested frame
Pause ends the audible node; resume uses the new simulation offset without a duplicate
Changing room or stem disconnects the old graph and isolates the requested recipe
All requested mixes/stems keep at most four authored PCM buffers
An isolated audition lasts exactly 12 seconds, then cannot restart on a volume update
Master and ambience zero silence their bus without changing effect preferences
Failed AudioContext and failed buffer start stay nonfatal and clean up the source
Legacy family audio remains byte-identical and missing R15 module falls back safely
Real combat snapshots select the room without mutating state, events or RNG
End, stop, navigation parking and final disposal cannot leave a scene playing
Workshop has no autoplay, no persistence and no stale room/layer after an empty search
The two real game consumers load the shared composition before their audio controller
Roster, all historical files of art, stage data, core engine and replay contracts remain exact R14
